evidence_class: mocked: fixture transcript files in a temporary folder and SQLite catalog and import ledger files stand in for the operator's real Claude and Codex homes and the central database; no live provider home was read
interfaces: hooks.memory.importer.import_sessions(catalog, imports, grant, plan, dry_run=False) refuses the whole plan before any read or write when it names no root, a provider other than claude or codex, an alias folder that is not an absolute path without '..', an alias project outside the Grant, or a root whose corpus is not the granted corpus; otherwise it reads every *.jsonl under each approved root in path order and reports every source with outcome committed, replayed, already_imported, would_import, no_records or refused

hooks.memory.importer.read_source(provider, data, aliases) splits the source bytes into newline terminated lines, normalizes each parseable object line once with the SV2-SES-01 decoders, drops the raw entry and adds source_time, gives each record its own sequence and the line's byte range, and reports an incomplete final line as truncated and a line that is not a JSON object as unparseable with its byte range

hooks.memory.importer.resolve_project(cwd, aliases) returns the project of the longest aliased absolute folder containing the working folder in effect at that line, and None for anything else, so a folder sharing only a basename with an aliased folder stays unattributed and is listed in ambiguous_basenames

Each committed source carries provenance: provider, installation, path relative to its root, sha256 and size of the source bytes, importer_version, native session id and whether it came from the transcript or the file name, provider version, working folders, first and last event time, projects, unattributed event count, ambiguous basenames and losses; every optional field the source lacks is null and named in unknown, with project named when any event is unattributed

Each source is one hooks.memory.api.ingest batch with batch_id and source_generation import:<source sha256> and session_uid <corpus>:<provider>:<installation>:<native session id>; hooks.memory.importer.ImportLedger marks it only after ingest returned committed or replayed, so a rerun skips it by source hash and a source committed before its mark is replayed by the catalog with no second copy

hooks.memory.importer.ImportLedger.search(catalog, domain, text) returns imported events whose text, tool name, tool input or tool result contains the text, ignoring case, with their session, generation, event id, sequence, byte range, project, record and source attribution

hooks.memory.importer.ImportLedger.export(catalog, domain) returns every import projection with its catalog events and their digest; retire(catalog, domain, export) deletes only the import ledger rows of the domain, and only when the export digest matches its records and the current projections; catalog events are kept

python -m scripts.swarm_v2.import_sessions takes --catalog, --imports, --corpus, --principal, repeated --project, --root PROVIDER:INSTALLATION:FOLDER, --alias FOLDER=PROJECT and --expected PROVIDER:INSTALLATION:RELATIVE_PATH and --dry-run, prints the report and exits 0 when completed and 2 when refused

supported_versions.providers: Claude Code JSONL transcripts and Codex JSONL rollouts as the SV2-SES-01 decoders read them; a bare JSON array transcript is reported as unparseable lines
supported_versions.storage: SQLite catalog and import ledger with WAL journal and synchronous FULL

states.observed: Cases A, B and C each ran twice from independent temporary folders with identical records.
states.accepted: A plan is accepted when every root is approved for the granted corpus and every alias is an absolute folder of a granted project; a source is accepted when ingest returns committed or replayed.
states.committed: A source is marked imported in the import ledger only after its catalog transaction committed; the report names each source's outcome.
states.externally_verified: None: no real provider home, central database or deployed service was read or written.

metrics.historical_import_unknown_attribution: events committed with a null project: per run in the report and durable per access domain through ImportLedger.unknown_attribution

rollback_rehearsal.action: Export the import projections with ImportLedger.export, then ImportLedger.retire with that export removes only the import ledger rows, after which search returns nothing for the domain.
rollback_rehearsal.authoritative_objects: The source transcript files and the catalog's session_event, session_quarantine, session_ingest_batch and session_watermark rows; retire deletes none of them.
rollback_rehearsal.proof: Case C exports after a crash, resume, rerun and grown source, retires with the export, finds no import projection or search hit, and counts the same catalog events as the export holds.

remaining_limitations: The importer reads only roots the caller names; it does not locate provider homes on its own.
One source file is one ingest batch, so a very large transcript is committed in one transaction.
A Claude sub agent transcript that reuses its parent's session id gets the parent's session_uid with its own source generation; parent and child are not linked.
Bare JSON array transcripts and Copilot sessions are not imported.
A source that grows after import is imported again as a new source generation; earlier generations are kept, not merged.
Search is a substring scan over the import ledger and catalog, not an index.
compatibility: Explicitly local compatibility path: imported events go through hooks.memory.api.ingest unchanged, so they share the SV2-SES-04 event identity, scope check and quarantine rules; the collector, spool, whole file reader and catalog are untouched.
authority: The corpus and projects come from the caller's Grant and the roots and aliases the operator names; a project label, folder basename or display name in a transcript never grants a project.
